$comment: Public build-time trust for release builds (scripts/build.mjs). Public verification values only:
the private signing key never goes here or in the build env (build.mjs throws if it is set).
An env var with the same name overrides a value here; null leaves it unset.
MYR5_MATERIAL_*: Ed25519 public key + commit-pinned raw host for the creature-skin and ship/biome
post-download sections. The nine signed manifests are in materials/<section>/chunk-manifest.json;
the build verifies each against this key before copying it to /materials/. Recovered 2026-09-26
from Codex's release 2 build (site-b0dea68, 22 Sep); later Sites builds, incl. live v65, dropped them.
PUBLIC_EXPANSION_SIGNING_JWK: no expansion key has ever been published (null in every release).
